item.title: Vestas Secures 390 MW Offshore Order for Shinan-Ui Project in South Korea
item.description: Vestas has received a 390 MW order for the Shinan-Ui offshore wind project in Jeollanam Province, South Korea, marking its first offshore wind order in the country. item.title: PM Surya Ghar: UPNEDA Plans to Cancel Licences of Suspicious Rooftop Solar Vendors
item.description: In a move to tighten the noose around suspicious vendors registered under the PM Surya Ghar scheme, the Uttar Pradesh government has issued show-cause notices to several such entities. The Uttar Pradesh New and Renewable Energy Development Agency (UPNEDA), the state’s nodal agency for implementing the scheme, has asked these vendors to explain their lack of activity. item.title: Green Stocks Dec 30- KPI Green Zooms As Investors Await End of 2025
item.description: In one of its biggest spikes in a day, EPC player KPI Green Energy was up as much as 17% at one point, as the stock zoomed up. With no formal filing by the firm, it is anyone's guess what caused the jump, although it did announce a small order win for a waste-to-energy plant from NTPC yesterday. If it's a re-rating based on an entry into a new segment, we believe it is still overrated, although the firm's valuation itself remains more than fair. item.title: Mahindra Susten Commissions 560 MWp Of Solar Capacity in 2025
item.description: Mahindra Susten, the renewable energy arm of India’s Mahindra Group, said on Tuesday it had commissioned 560 megawatt-peak (MWp) of utility-scale solar capacity during calendar year 2025. The newly commissioned capacity comprises two solar projects of 280 MWp each in Gujarat and Rajasthan. Power from the projects will be supplied under 25-year power purchase agreements to Gujarat Urja Vikas Nigam Ltd and Rajasthan Urja Vikas Nigam Ltd, respectively, the company said. item.description: Bengaluru-based Pace Digitek Limited today announced a key win as its material subsidiary, Lineage Power Private Limited, has received an order from state owned telecom firm Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited (BSNL). item.title: Khavda: Adani Green Energy Starts 307.4 MW Power Projects
item.description: Adani Green Energy Limited, through its various step-down subsidiaries, has operationalised an aggregate of 307.4 MW of power projects at Khavda, Gujarat. item.description: Gujarat Urja Vikas Nigam (GUVNL) has recently awarded a Wind Power tender in Gujarat to four winning bidders out of the original six bidders, bidding out a 306 MW wind power project out of the 250 MW project tender with a greenshoe option. item.title: Tamil Nadu Extends 100 percent EV Road Tax Exemption Until 2027
item.description: Tamil Nadu government has extended its 100 per cent road tax exemption for all battery operated vehicles by two years - from January 1, 2026, to December 31, 2027. The decision, announced through a government order issued on December 29, aims to sustain the state’s momentum in promoting clean mobility and supporting local EV manufacturing.
